content.text: Using a belt tension gauge, check the drive belt tension.
"New belt" refers to a brand new belt which has never before been used.
"Used belt" refers to a belt which has been used on a running engine for 5 minutes or more.

content.description: Power steering pump with belt and reservoir tank location shown
Belt tension gauge tools - Nippondenso and Borroughs models shown

items:
BOOST FLUID TEMPERATURE
With the engine idling at 1,000 rpm or less, turn the steering wheel from lock to lock several times to boost the fluid temperature.
Fluid temperature:   80°C (176°F)

CHECK FOR FOAMING OR EMULSIFICATION
NOTE:   Foaming and emulsification indicates the presence of air in the system or that the fluid level is too low.

CHECK FLUID LEVEL IN RESERVOIR TANK
Check the fluid level and add fluid if necessary.
Fluid:   ATF DEXRON® or DEXRON® II
NOTE:   Check that the fluid level is within the HOT LEVEL of the dipstick. If the fluid is cold, check that it is within the COLD LEVEL of the dipstick.
